description: This file contains the implementation of a presentation (PowerPoint) generator using the 'pptxgenjs' library. It includes functions for handling data URLs, applying transformations, resolving template placeholders, rendering slides with layout considerations, and exporting the final PPTX as a Blob. The core exported function is 'generatePptx', which creates a presentation based on a template, user data, and slide order.

methods.name: isProbablyDataUrl(v)
methods.description: Checks if a given string starts with 'data:', indicating it's a data URL.

methods.name: fileToDataUrl(file)
methods.description: Converts a File object or string to a Data URL, handling file reading asynchronously.

methods.name: urlToDataUrl(url)
methods.description: Fetches a URL and converts the response Blob to a Data URL.

methods.name: applyTransform(value, transformName)
methods.description: Applies specific transformations to values based on the provided transform name, such as formatting percentages or currencies.

methods.name: resolveDeckTitle(wizardData)
methods.description: Determines the title of the deck based on wizard data, defaulting to 'presentation' if none found.

methods.name: safeFileName(name)
methods.description: Sanitizes and truncates a string to be a safe filename.

methods.name: resolveValueForStep(wizardData, slideStep, fieldId)
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate value for a slide step, considering scope and grouping in wizard data.

methods.name: ptToIn(pt)
methods.description: Converts points to inches for positioning in PowerPoint slides.

methods.name: addFallbackText(slide, i, placeholderId, value)
methods.description: Adds placeholder text to a slide when actual data is missing.

methods.name: addFallbackImage(slide, i, placeholderId, fileOrUrl)
methods.description: Adds a placeholder or missing image notice to a slide when image data is unavailable.

methods.name: renderFixedShapes(slide, layout, templateIndex)
methods.description: Renders fixed shapes (rectangles, pictures) in a slide based on layout's fixedShapes property.

methods.name: generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData })
methods.description: Main exported function that constructs a PPTX presentation given templates, slide order, and data, then returns a Blob and filename.

ctags.name: generatePptx
ctags.pattern: /^export async function generatePptx({ templateModel, extractedTemplate, orderedSlides, wizardData/
